title: G7 complete preflight accepted a source G6 arm inconsistent with the diagnostic group
evidence: Before repair, a read-only probe built from the valid formal G7 case fixture and changed every G3 row from G6_A_G3_GIVEN to G6_B_G4_GIVEN. protocol_preflight(..., require_complete_plan=True) returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[], so a group/source-arm identity swap could pass the structural gate.
remediation: Define the documented G3/G4 source-arm mapping in the runner and reject every complete-plan row whose source_g6_arm_id does not match its group_id. Add an adversarial regression test, correct the preflight test fixture, and rerun the immutable formal plan.
